title: Infinity Nova
description: Adds the Infinity Stones and Gauntlet to Minecraft
body:
# Infinity Nova

Infinity Nova adds the Infinity Stones, the Tesseract, and the Infinity Gauntlet to Minecraft, each with unique abilities faithful to their lore.

**Included items:**
- Mind Stone, Power Stone, Reality Stone, Soul Stone, Space Stone, Time Stone
- The Tesseract
- The Infinity Gauntlet

**No crafting recipes are included by design.** Modpack creators and server owners can define their own recipes and progression using **KubeJS** or **CraftTweaker**, keeping full control over how rare and difficult to obtain these items are.

This mod is intended as a building block for custom modpacks and server experiences — not a standalone play-and-craft mod. If you want the Infinity Stones in your world on your terms, this is your foundation.
